name: PoPayPOS Reports for WooCommerce
author: Matat Technologies

sections.description:
PoPayPOS Reports for WooCommerce is a powerful analytics plugin designed specifically for businesses using PopayPOS (Omni POS) systems with WooCommerce. Get comprehensive insights into your point-of-sale transactions with professional reports, visual analytics, and data export capabilities.

Transform your Popay POS data into actionable business intelligence with detailed sales reports, payment method tracking, and employee performance analytics.

Why Choose PoPayPOS Reports?
✅ 100% HPOS Compatible – Future-proof with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
✅ Real-time Analytics – Track sales performance instantly
✅ Professional Reports – Export to CSV/Excel for business analysis
✅ Visual Dashboards – Beautiful charts and graphs
✅ Payment Method Tracking – Monitor all payment types
✅ Employee Performance – Track individual cashier sales

Perfect for Popay users who need detailed reporting and analytics for their POS transactions.

The plugin allows site administrators to view detailed analytics for POS orders, including:
– Comparison between Popay POS orders and regular orders
– Daily detailed reports with visual graphs
– Export data to CSV/Excel formats
– Detailed statistics and performance metrics
– Full compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

Popay Invoice (optional, off by default)
Issue Israeli tax documents for your website orders and refunds through your Popay business: tax invoice/receipt, tax invoice or receipt per order, and a credit invoice with its refund receipt per refund. Documents are numbered in your Popay series, carry a SHAAM allocation number when the law requires one, and are linked on the order, in the orders list and optionally in the customer email. Orders created by the Popay POS register are never documented again here: the register already issued them. Turn it on under WooCommerce → Settings → Popay POS → Invoice, with an API key from Popay (Integrations → API Keys).

System Requirements

  • WordPress 5.3 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • PopayPOS/Omni POS system integration
  • Popay Invoice: WordPress 6.2 and WooCommerce 8.0 or higher, and a Popay business on Popay invoicing

Compatibility

This plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
It uses the WooCommerce Data Store API instead of direct SQL queries, ensuring compatibility with future database changes.

Supported features:
– HPOS enabled
– HPOS disabled (traditional database)
– Automatic switching between systems
– Support for WooCommerce 5.0+

Usage

Accessing Reports

  1. Go to the WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce > PoPayPOS Reports

Creating a Report

  1. Select a start date and end date
  2. Click Generate Report
  3. View results in summary cards, graphs, and tables

Exporting Data

  1. Generate a report
  2. Select an export format (CSV or Excel)
  3. Click Export Report

Popay Invoice

  • Each order gets its document when it is paid (or reaches the status you chose); each refund gets a credit invoice and, when money went back, a refund receipt
  • The documents appear in the Popay documents box on the order page, in the Popay column of the orders list, and (optionally) as a link in the customer’s order email
  • If a document could not be issued, the order box says why and offers Retry; nothing is issued twice
  • Orders from the Popay POS register are skipped: the register already issued their documents

Features

Summary Cards

  • Number of POS orders
  • Total POS order amount
  • Number of regular orders
  • Total regular order amount
  • Total revenue
  • Percentage of POS orders from all orders

Graphs

  • Line chart comparing daily revenue
  • Bar chart comparing daily order counts

Detailed Tables

  • List of all POS orders with direct links
  • Daily breakdown of orders and revenue

Data Export

  • Export to CSV
  • Export to Excel (basic)

Popay Invoice (optional)

  • Tax invoice/receipt, tax invoice or receipt per order, chosen from what your Popay business may issue
  • Credit invoice with its refund receipt per refund
  • Coupons, shipping and fees on the document as on the order, to the agora
  • Numbered in your Popay series, with a SHAAM allocation number when required
  • Off by default; register orders never documented twice

Data Structure

The plugin identifies orders with the meta field:
order_source = pos
Orders without this field or with a different value are considered regular orders.

Technical Architecture

WooCommerce Data Store API

Instead of direct SQL queries:
php
$orders = wc_get_orders(array(
'limit' => -1,
'status' => array('completed', 'processing', 'on-hold'),
'meta_query' => array(
array(
'key' => 'order_source',
'value' => 'pos',
'compare' => '='
)
)
));

HPOS Detection

`php

if (class_exists(‘Automattic\WooCommerce\Utilities\OrderUtil’)) {
$hpos_enabled = \Automattic\WooCommerce\Utilities\OrderUtil::custom_orders_table_usage_is_enabled();
}
`

Customization

Adding More Fields

Edit the get_orders_by_source function:
php
private function get_orders_by_source($source, $start_date, $end_date) {
$args = array(
'limit' => -1,
'status' => array('completed', 'processing', 'on-hold'),
'date_created' => $start_date . '...' . $end_date,
'orderby' => 'date',
'order' => 'DESC',
'meta_query' => array(
array(
'key' => 'your_custom_field',
'value' => 'your_value',
'compare' => '='
)
)
);
return wc_get_orders($args);
}

Styling

Edit assets/css/admin.css.

Troubleshooting

  • Plugin not in menu: Ensure WooCommerce is active and you have manage_woocommerce permissions.
  • No data in reports: Make sure orders contain order_source = pos and check the date range.
  • JavaScript errors: Verify all assets are loading and check browser console.
  • HPOS issues: Ensure WooCommerce is updated.

Performance

  • Uses WooCommerce Data Store API for efficiency
  • HPOS improves performance
  • Optimized queries for the active database
  • Loads orders in small batches to save memory

Support

For questions or support, contact the plugin developer.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.

External services

The optional Popay Invoice feature connects to the Popay API, operated by Matat Technologies, to issue tax documents. Nothing is sent until it is enabled under WooCommerce → Settings → Popay POS → Invoice.

  • What is sent: when an order is paid (or reaches the status you chose) and when it is refunded, the order’s number, items, prices, discounts, shipping, payment method details (card type, last four digits, authorisation code), and the billing customer’s name, company, tax ID (if you map one), email and phone.
  • “Test connection” and the Invoice settings send your API key to read your business’s name and the document types it may issue.
  • Where: https://dash.popaypos.com (live) or https://stg-app.popaypos.com (Development mode, for testing).

Terms of use: https://popaypos.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://popaypos.com/privacy-policy

The reports themselves read your WooCommerce orders only and send nothing anywhere.
sections.installation:
From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “PoPayPOS Reports” or “Popay”
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > PoPayPOS Reports

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the popaypos-reports folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in your WordPress admin
  4. Find PoPayPOS Reports for WooCommerce and activate it
  5. Navigate to WooCommerce > PoPayPOS Reports

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.3+
  • WooCommerce 5.0+
  • PHP 7.4+
  • PoPayPOS/Omni POS system integration

Turning on Popay Invoice (optional)

  1. In Popay, go to Integrations > API Keys and create a key
  2. In WordPress, go to WooCommerce > Settings > Popay POS > Invoice
  3. Paste the key and click Test connection: it shows your Popay business name
  4. Choose when to issue and which document, tick Enable and save
sections.faq:
Does updating change anything in my store?

No. Popay Invoice is off until you enable it under WooCommerce > Settings > Popay POS > Invoice. The reports work as before.

Do I need a Popay account for invoicing?

Yes. Documents are issued by your Popay business, under its VAT number and numbering. The plugin connects your store to it with an API key. A business that invoices through another provider (such as iCount) is told so, and nothing is issued.

What is “Development mode”?

A setting for testing: documents go to Popay’s staging server instead of the live one, so nothing real is issued. Leave it off on a live store.

Can a document be issued twice for the same order?

No. Each order and each refund is sent with its own key, and Popay returns the existing document for a repeated request.

What happens to the documents if I uninstall?

They stay. The documents live in Popay, and the references on your orders are kept; uninstalling removes only the plugin’s settings.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • New: optional Popay Invoice. Issues Israeli tax documents (tax invoice/receipt, tax invoice, receipt, credit invoice with refund receipt) for website orders and refunds through Popay. Off by default; settings under WooCommerce → Settings → Popay POS → Invoice
  • Popay POS settings now have two sections: General and Invoice
  • Orders from the Popay POS register are never documented twice: the register already issued them
  • Bundled Hebrew translation is now loaded
  • Minimum WordPress is now 5.3 (the reports already used wp_date()); the invoicing part needs WordPress 6.2 and WooCommerce 8.0 or newer

2.2.1

  • The orders list source filter (POS / online) now also works under HPOS

2.2.0

  • The orders list source filter now filters on the indexed status column (faster on large stores)

2.1.1

  • Moved the order-statuses endpoint to GET /wc/v3/popay-order-statuses so it authenticates with WooCommerce REST API consumer keys

2.1.0

  • Added REST endpoint GET /wc/v3/popay-order-statuses returning all order statuses, including custom ones (e.g. Popay POS)
  • Customer search result limit is now adjustable per request via the “search_limit” query param (default 50, max 500)

2.0.5

  • Fixed customer search returning too many results for multi-word names (e.g. “First Last” no longer matches every customer sharing just the first name)
  • Customer search now mirrors WooCommerce core: the whole search term is matched against name, email, phone, and company fields
  • Added word-by-word fallback that matches names split across first/last name fields when an exact phrase match is not found
  • Bounded the customer search result set to keep queries fast on common terms

2.0.4

  • Added info note about Popay POS connection status on Settings page
  • Minor UI improvements to Settings page header layout

2.0.3

  • Aligned POPAYPOS_REPORTS_VERSION constant with plugin header
  • Added Settings link to PoPayPOS Reports page header
  • Added Settings button to page header with flex layout

2.0.0

  • Major update with WooCommerce Analytics style interface
  • Added refund tracking and reporting
  • Added payment method breakdown charts
  • Added employee/user filtering
  • Improved performance and code structure
  • Full PHPCS compliance
  • Enhanced REST API for customer phone search

1.0.4

  • Enhanced search visibility for “Popay” searches
  • Improved plugin description and tags
  • Better SEO optimization

1.0.3

  • Rename for compatibility with WordPress repository

1.0.1

  • Full HPOS compatibility
  • Uses WooCommerce Data Store API
  • Automatic HPOS detection
  • Admin interface compatibility notices
  • Significant performance improvements

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Basic reports
  • Visual graphs
  • Data export
  • Modern user interface
